model.description: Caller-selected Model ID, Endpoint ID, or Agent Plan model name. No automatic model substitution.

content.description: Native Seedance text/image_url/video_url/audio_url parts, including reference roles and draft_task when supported.

resolution.description: Model-supported output resolution preset, e.g. 720p (pixel resolution class); not a byte size.

ratio.description: Dimensionless output width:height aspect ratio, e.g. 16:9; supported values depend on the model.

duration.description: Generated video duration in seconds (s), e.g. 5 for five seconds; -1 requests automatic duration only for models that support it. Model-specific limits apply.

frames.description: Total generated video frames (frame count), not frames per second. Provider rules determine supported counts and precedence over duration.

seed.description: Dimensionless random seed (integer), not a count or duration; allowed values and sentinel values depend on the model.

execution_expires_after.description: Task expiry interval in seconds (s) from provider created_at, covering queued and running time; not an absolute timestamp or video duration. Provider range/default apply.
